name: chimpvibe
description: Contribute to the games on chimpvibe.dev — the ONE server (chimpvibe.dev/mcp) and the contribute wizard.

token.title: ChimpVibe member token
token.description: The token from your ChimpVibe kit (the owner minted it for you). It is yours alone; it never leaves your machine except as the Authorization header to chimpvibe.dev. Stored in your Claude Code settings like any `claude mcp add --header` token.
